purpose: Prevent inference, PASS inheritance, and promotion before durable evidence is proven

gate_meaning.DB_EXISTENCE: Database existence is independently evidenced; it does not grant access.
gate_meaning.DB_BINDING: Service binding is independently evidenced; it does not imply TLS admission.
gate_meaning.DB_TLS_ADMISSION: Binding satisfies explicit TLS policy; it does not imply durable round-trip success.
gate_meaning.DB_ROUND_TRIP: Independent compact metadata write/read with SHA-256 match is observed.
gate_meaning.PROMOTION: Only complete evidence-backed chain may promote the database to durable evidence sink.

test_governance: If a test conflicts with an immutable higher-order Forensic rule, fix the test when the code preserves the invariant; never weaken the invariant to make the test green.
successor_rule: A successor may evaluate only the next gate after evidence proves the current gate. It may not infer deeper state from a shallower PASS.
